acceptance_criteria: Every degraded or unhealthy chat, passive, and agent runtime snapshot carries a registered cause or explicit invalid-contract state.
Chat queue backlog does not serialize as unclassified.
Chat compatibility rejection retains a bounded compatibility cause without raw database details.
Passive query failure is distinct from a measured zero unread count and from healthy state.
Top-level status and cause membership come from the same runtime observation and generation.
Unknown, malformed, or missing causes fail toward visible invalid-contract state.
A new runtime degraded predicate without a cause makes the guard fail.
Fleet, alert, and console fixtures can consume the new causes without parsing runtime details or free-form evidence.
All public, log, and alert fixtures contain only synthetic, content-free values.

falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding is falsified if every degraded or unhealthy runtime snapshot carries a bounded cause from the same observation and core validates and projects it for all runtime modes. Exact-main source tracing disproved those conditions: known chat and passive failures change status without causes, while core's cause mapping is gated by agentRuntimeStatus and otherwise emits unclassified. This review did not author a temporary end-to-end test asserting the exact unclassified body for every chat/passive predicate; the existing 158 green tests establish the local snapshots and generic status propagation, and the decisive production branch proves the empty-vector fallback.
impact: Known chat queue pressure, stale enrichment, compatibility rejection, and passive health-query failure collapse to unclassified at the public health boundary. Downstream alert, fleet, and console consumers cannot apply stable severity, ownership, action, freshness, or recovery policy without re-parsing mode-specific details.

suggested_remediation: Extend RuntimeHealth with one versioned bounded observation containing status, registered causes, observation availability, and observed_at. Adopt it in chat and passive runtimes, require every non-healthy result to carry a cause or explicit invalid-contract state, and make core validate and project that observation instead of re-deriving selected agent details. Preserve existing agent causes during migration, register the all-mode vocabulary through #2447, and add mode-local truth tables, end-to-end health fixtures, drift enforcement, and exact-byte privacy checks.
